original.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: final playable 2D pixel RPG battle background, NOT a mockup. Create a rich original mid-1990s DOS Chinese wuxia RPG forest-temple courtyard in the visual craft of classic 1995 Sword and Fairy. Compose a very wide 2.46:1 landscape, exactly 1600x650 if possible, sharp hand-placed pixel art, limited sophisticated earthy jade/ochre/slate palette, colored outlines, clustered dithering, NO smooth digital painting. Fixed elevated isometric 45 degree camera, ground diagonals slopes +0.5 and -0.5. A broad worn grey sandstone diamond platform fills most of image: rear vertex (760,10), right vertex (1530,390), near vertex (810,760) partly below image, left vertex (80,350). Lots of readable uncluttered fighting space around enemy foot at (535,330) and hero foot at (1085,530). Thin ornate stone border, irregular cracked slabs in many subtle shades, sparse moss between stones, faded small taoist seal on floor near (800,375). Around edges only: richly textured bamboo forest, old twisted pine, moss-covered boulders, fern fronds, tiny warm stone lanterns, broken low balustrade along rear diagonals, small fragment of traditional tiled roof in upper left corner. Sun-dappled surfaces, gentle mist in forest recesses. Dense authored environmental detail, real pixel game art, atmosphere and material depth. No characters, no weapons, no monsters, no UI, no text, no logo, no grid overlay. Keep playable floor perspective exactly isometric and ground flat; no eye-level horizon. Avoid large empty flat polygons or repeated pristine tiles.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite atlas for a classic 1995 DOS Chinese wuxia RPG, ORIGINAL character. Each of the 8 cells shows the SAME slender young Chinese swordsman, SAME scale, feet centered at cell-local x128,y472, clear transparent spacing. Figure height about 340px, delicate 5.5 heads tall, NOT chibi, NOT a blocky doll. Facing NORTHWEST (upper left) in every cell, viewed at isometric 45 degrees from behind-right: dark hair crown and back visible, small left cheek, flowing black ponytail tied in muted blue, warm ivory cross-collar hanfu, layered pale blue-grey tunic and split long robe, navy belt with small jade clasp, dark trousers and boots, worn scabbard, slim silver straight jian with brass guard. Crisp authentic hand-placed pixel-art clusters/dithered cloth shading with 5-7 tone ramps, fine hair strands/hem folds/boot highlights, earthy restrained DOS palette, no blur or antialiasing. Think logical 64x128 pixel cells enlarged 4x nearest neighbor. Row-major frames: 0 ready stance with sword low pointing northwest; 1 crouched anticipation with torso twisted and sword drawn back; 2 forward running step, ponytail and robe trailing southeast; 3 sword raised high over shoulder preparing strike; 4 committed northwest diagonal sword slash, deep front lunge, rear leg extended and sleeves flaring; 5 follow-through lowered sword and body recovering balance; 6 spellcast with two-finger sword mudra left hand raised northwest and sword held vertically, sleeves lifted; 7 hurt recoil leaning back southeast with bent knees. Make whole-body silhouettes change clearly through attack frames, preserve the same identity, correct consistent camera direction, eight separate complete poses. Weapons and long sleeves must stay inside their cell. Absolutely NO scenery, no platform, no shadows, no grid, no words. True alpha-transparent background.
